#### Project general facts

Reem Nine by SAAS Properties is a 20-storey residential development on Al Reem Island, Abu Dhabi, featuring two basement levels, a ground floor, and a contemporary architectural design. The project offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments alongside commercial spaces. The residences are designed to maximise natural light and provide views of the surrounding mangroves, waterfront promenade, and city skyline.

The development offers a range of amenities for recreation, fitness, and relaxation, including a swimming pool, fitness club, sauna, private cinema, and padel tennis court. Additional facilities include a children's playground, lounge area, outdoor sports facilities, retail shops, and concierge services, providing residents with convenient options for leisure and everyday needs.

The apartments feature spacious layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and contemporary interiors in neutral tones. Open-plan living areas create a sense of space, while the kitchens are equipped with modern appliances and sleek countertops. The residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing owners to customise their interiors according to their preferences.

#### Location description and benefits

Reem Nine is located on Al Reem Island, a waterfront district just off the coast of Abu Dhabi. The development is positioned near a canal promenade, offering access to waterfront walks and views of the surrounding landscape. The island combines residential neighbourhoods with retail, leisure, and commercial developments, providing an urban lifestyle alongside natural surroundings.

Al Reem Island is known for its waterfront setting and proximity to mangrove areas, which offer opportunities to enjoy outdoor recreation and scenic views. The district also provides access to shopping destinations, restaurants, healthcare facilities, and educational institutions, supporting the needs of residents and families.

The island benefits from road connections to central Abu Dhabi and other parts of the city, making it convenient for commuting and accessing major business and lifestyle destinations. Its combination of waterfront surroundings, established infrastructure, and ongoing urban development makes Al Reem Island an attractive residential location for those seeking access to city amenities in a coastal setting.
